verses.he: לְדָוִ֗ד מַ֫שְׂכִּ֥יל אַשְׁרֵ֥י נְֽשׂוּי־פֶּ֗שַׁע כְּס֣וּי חֲטָאָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ. قَصِيدَةٌ طُوبَى لِلَّذِي غُفِرَ إِثْمُهُ وَسُتِرَتْ خَطِيَّتُهُ.
verses.en: A Psalm of David. Maschil. Happy is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is pardoned.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David, Maschil. Blessed [is he whose] transgression [is] forgiven, [whose] sin [is] covered.
verses.web: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.he: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָ֗ם לֹ֤א יַחְשֹׁ֬ב יְהוָ֣ה לֹ֣ו עָוֹ֑ן וְאֵ֖ין בְּרוּחֹ֣ו רְמִיָּה׃
verses.ar: طُوبَى لِرَجُلٍ لَا يَحْسِبُ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ خَطِيَّةً، وَلَا فِي رُوحِهِ غِشٌّ.
verses.en: Happy is the man unto whom the LORD counteth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit [there is] no guile.
verses.web: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

verses.ar: لَمَّا سَكَتُّ بَلِيَتْ عِظَامِي مِنْ زَفِيرِي ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ،
verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones wore away through my groaning all the day long.
verses.kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.web: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

verses.he: כִּ֤י ׀ יֹומָ֣ם וָלַיְלָה֮ תִּכְבַּ֥ד עָלַ֗י יָ֫דֶ֥ךָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְשַׁדִּ֑י בְּחַרְבֹ֖נֵי קַ֣יִץ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ يَدَكَ ثَقُلَتْ عَلَيَّ نَهَارًا وَلَيْلًا. تَحَوَّلَتْ رُطُوبَتِي إِلَى يُبُوسَةِ ٱلْقَيْظِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me; my sap was turned as in the droughts of summer. Selah
verses.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.web: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

verses.he: חַטָּאתִ֨י אֹודִ֪יעֲךָ֡ וַעֲוֹ֘נִ֤י לֹֽא־כִסִּ֗יתִי אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֹודֶ֤ה עֲלֵ֣י פְ֭שָׁעַי לַיהוָ֑ה וְאַתָּ֨ה נָ֘שָׂ֤אתָ עֲוֹ֖ן חַטָּאתִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَعْتَرِفُ لَكَ بِخَطِيَّتِي وَلَا أَكْتُمُ إِثْمِي. قُلْتُ: «أَعْتَرِفُ لِلرَّبِّ بِذَنْبِي» وَأَنْتَ رَفَعْتَ أَثَامَ خَطِيَّتِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: I acknowledged my sin unto Thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid; I said: 'I will make confession concerning my transgressions unto the LORD' — and Thou, Thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah
verses.kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.web: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.he: עַל־זֹ֡את יִתְפַּלֵּ֬ל כָּל־חָסִ֨יד ׀ אֵלֶיךָ֮ לְעֵ֪ת מְ֫צֹ֥א רַ֗ק לְ֭שֵׁטֶף מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים אֵ֝לָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיעוּ׃
verses.ar: لِهَذَا يُصَلِّي لَكَ كُلُّ تَقِيٍّ فِي وَقْتٍ يَجِدُكَ فِيهِ. عِنْدَ غَمَارَةِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ إِيَّاهُ لَا تُصِيبُ.
verses.en: For this let every one that is godly pray unto Thee in a time when Thou mayest be found; surely, when the great waters overflow, they will not reach unto him.
verses.kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.web: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ סֵ֥תֶר לִי֮ מִצַּ֪ר תִּ֫צְּרֵ֥נִי רָנֵּ֥י פַלֵּ֑ט תְּסֹ֖ובְבֵ֣נִי סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ سِتْرٌ لِي. مِنَ ٱلضِّيقِ تَحْفَظُنِي. بِتَرَنُّمِ ٱلنَّجَاةِ تَكْتَنِفُنِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thou art my hiding-place; Thou wilt preserve me from the adversary; with songs of deliverance Thou wilt compass me about. Selah
verses.kjv: Thou [art] my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.web: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.he: אַשְׂכִּֽילְךָ֨ ׀ וְֽאֹורְךָ֗ בְּדֶֽרֶךְ־ז֥וּ תֵלֵ֑ךְ אִֽיעֲצָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יךָ עֵינִֽי׃
verses.ar: «أُعَلِّمُكَ وَأُرْشِدُكَ ٱلطَّرِيقَ ٱلَّتِي تَسْلُكُهَا. أَنْصَحُكَ. عَيْنِي عَلَيْكَ.
verses.en: 'I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go; I will give counsel, Mine eye being upon thee.'
verses.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.web: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

verses.he: אַל־תִּֽהְי֤וּ ׀ כְּס֥וּס כְּפֶרֶד֮ אֵ֤ין הָ֫בִ֥ין בְּמֶֽתֶג־וָרֶ֣סֶן עֶדְיֹ֣ו לִבְלֹ֑ום בַּ֝֗ל קְרֹ֣ב אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: لَا تَكُونُوا كَفَرَسٍ أَوْ بَغْلٍ بِلَا فَهْمٍ. بِلِجَامٍ وَزِمَامٍ زِينَتِهِ يُكَمُّ لِئَلَّا يَدْنُوَ إِلَيْكَ».
verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, that they come not near unto thee.
verses.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, [or] as the mule, [which] have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

verses.he: רַבִּ֥ים מַכְאֹובִ֗ים לָרָ֫שָׁ֥ע וְהַבֹּוטֵ֥חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה חֶ֝֗סֶד יְסֹובְבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.ar: كَثِيرَةٌ هِيَ نَكَبَاتُ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ، أَمَّا ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَٱلرَّحْمَةُ تُحِيطُ بِهِ.
verses.en: Many are the sorrows of the wicked; but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy compasseth him about.
verses.kjv: Many sorrows [shall be] to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.web: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

verses.he: שִׂמְח֬וּ בַֽיהוָ֣ה וְ֭גִילוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝הַרְנִ֗ינוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.ar: ٱفْرَحُوا بِٱلرَّبِّ وَٱبْتَهِجُوا يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ، وَٱهْتِفُوا يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقُلُوبِ.
verses.en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous; and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.kjv: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all [ye that are] upright in heart.
verses.web: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!
